notes.title: Leaderboard Display Update
notes.content: This update fixes an issue with leaderboard display and optimizes the interface layout to ensure players can view rankings more clearly. Thank you for your patience, and we hope you enjoy an improved experience!

notes.title: Update: Enhanced Controls and Friendly Prompts
notes.content: This update brings significant improvements to the overall control experience, making gameplay smoother and more intuitive. We’ve also added a few friendly prompts to assist players during key moments. Enjoy a more refined and user-friendly experience!
